name: std::ostreambuf_iterator<CharT,Traits>::failed
intro: Returns true if the iterator encountered the end-of-file condition, that is, if an earlier call to std::basic_streambuf::sputc (made by operator=) returned Traits::eof.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if this iterator has encountered the end-of-file condition on output, false otherwise.

examples.title: Practical use case
examples.input: Run the self-contained program; assertions check the documented behavior.
